alignments.note: The preposition takes the ASV's *At*; the ASV writes a separate word for the construct noun, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet and rule 2 splits the pair.

Construct noun with the supplied *the*: no article morpheme is present, so under rule 29 the determiner joins the construct noun's own unit. The relational *of* is the rectum's under rule 19 and is not taken here.

The numeral is the nomen rectum, so the *of* of the construct relation belongs to it under rule 19, headed on the word carrying the lexeme (*seven*) under rule 24. The distributive *every* is the numeral's under rules 15 and 41, which give a written distributive determiner to a numeral standing in the phrase rather than to the counted noun.
The counted noun takes only its own English word.

Finite verb with its subject pronoun and auxiliary under rule 17, headed on the lexical verb. *make ... a release* is not a light-verb complement construction of rule 44 here, since `שְׁמִטָּה` is a written source noun with its own English.
The indefinite *a* belongs to the noun that licenses it under rule 15 and is never `added`; head on the word carrying the lexeme.

review_notes: Competing reading considered for t004-t006: giving *of* to the construct noun `קֵץ` rather than to the numeral. Rule 19 is explicit that the relational expression belongs to the nomen rectum and that the construct noun's unit takes only its own English word, so the *of* is placed on `שֶׁבַע`.

Competing reading considered for *every*: leaving it with `שָׁנִים` as a supplied determiner on the nominal expression under rule 15. Rule 15's own limit sends a distributive *each* or *every* to a numeral standing in the phrase, so it is placed on `שֶׁבַע`.
